name: Quarantine
source:
There's a mild coding virus spreading through the Decepticon ranks. Fortunately, Megatron is immune. Unfortunately, Starscream isn't, and he's quarantined in Megatron's office.

[From [url=https://useless19.itch.io/quarantine]Itch.io[/url]]

A short story based on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/15247917]Quarantine[/url], a Transformers fan-fiction written by [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/neveralarch/pseuds/neveralarch]Neveralarch[/url].
